title: SelfSearch: Reward-Free Search for Self-Improving Agents
title_zh: SelfSearch: 无需奖励的代理自我改进搜索

paragraphs.en: Advances in the coding capabilities of LLM agents allow them to inspect and modify their own instructions, tools, and execution procedures. Existing approaches use this ability to search for improved agents through repeated downstream evaluation, which incurs substantial costs and ties the search to the evaluated tasks. We introduce SelfSearch , a reward-free search procedure in which agents modify themselves using records of previous self-improvement episodes. These records capture the reasoning, tool actions, and outcomes of earlier modification attempts, providing concrete experience for improving both task solving and self-modification. Without downstream reward signals during search, SelfSearch improves population-mean success over the initial agent in all six model–benchmark settings, with individual agents gaining up to 11.2 percentage points on Terminal-Bench 2.1. On SWE-bench Multilingual, an agent improves success by 5.0 percentage points while reducing execution cost by 38.5 % on tasks solved by both the initial and evolved agents. SelfSearch achieves competitive task success with evaluation-guided search baselines at lower search cost. With only $4.03 in search cost, it produces a harness that solves 82.0 % of Terminal-Bench 2.1 tasks with DeepSeek V4 Flash under the settings of a public nine-harness comparison, matching the top-scoring harness, Codex. These results suggest that experience gained through self-modification can improve agents’ downstream capabilities and efficiency.

paragraphs.en: Self-improvement involves recognizing limitations in our capabilities and developing ways to overcome them. In doing so, we gain experience not only with the problem at hand, but with how we identify weaknesses, test possible solutions, and respond to failure. Reflecting on this process can help us improve how we learn, a central concern of metacognition ( Flavell, 1979 ) . Can agents likewise use the experience of self-improvement to become better at improving themselves?
paragraphs.zh: 自我提升涉及认识到自身能力的局限性，并探索克服这些局限性的方法。 通过这一过程，我们不仅积累了应对当前问题的经验，也学会了如何识别弱点、测试可能的解决方案以及应对失败。 反思这一过程有助于我们改进学习方式，这也是元认知（Flavell, 1979）的核心关注点。 智能体是否也能利用自我提升的经验，从而更有效地实现自我提升呢？

paragraphs.en: The coding capabilities of LLM agents make it possible to investigate this question: agents can inspect and modify the implementations that govern their own behavior. Agents can learn from their own task-solving experiences and improve their capabilities over time ( Zhang et al., 2026a ; Wang et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026b ) . These approaches use downstream evaluation to guide the search process, tying the improvement signal to a task distribution and requiring repeated execution of candidate agents. Evaluating each candidate on a development set incurs a recurring cost that grows with the number of tasks evaluated.
paragraphs.zh: LLM 智能体的编码能力使得研究以下问题成为可能：智能体能够检查并修改控制其自身行为的实现方式。 智能体可以从自身的任务解决经验中学习，并随着时间的推移不断提升其能力（Zhang 等，2026a；Wang 等，2026；Zhang 等，2026b）。 这些方法利用下游评估来指导搜索过程，将改进信号与任务分布绑定，并要求对候选智能体进行重复执行。 在开发集上对每个候选智能体进行评估会产生重复成本，且该成本会随着所评估任务数量的增加而增长。

paragraphs.en: Task-solving experience provides evidence about how an agent performs, guiding the search for improvements. However, a modification produces not only a candidate agent, but also a record of the process that produced it. This record contains information about how the agent identified limitations, constructed revisions, and examined their effects. The experience of self-modification can therefore provide valuable evidence for future self-improvement.
paragraphs.zh: 任务解决经验为智能体的表现提供了证据，并指导着改进方向的探索。 然而，一次修改不仅会产生一个候选智能体，还会生成记录其产生过程的信息。 该记录包含了关于智能体如何识别局限性、构建修订方案以及检验其效果的信息。 因此，自我修改的经验可以为未来的自我提升提供宝贵的证据。

paragraphs.en: We introduce SelfSearch , a reward-free search procedure in which an agent modifies its own implementation using records of previous self-improvement episodes. The agent’s entire repository is editable, allowing it to revise its instructions, tools, execution logic, and code organization. A single agent performs both self-modification and downstream tasks, so changes to its implementation can affect both capabilities. Each episode produces a successor agent and a record of the modification process. These records capture how the agent gathers information, makes changes, and responds to failures. The successor uses them to guide the next episode, allowing experience and capabilities developed during self-modification to support further improvement. For example, difficulty inspecting long records may motivate a reusable inspection tool, while a failed edit may motivate a procedure that checks the relevant source before attempting a repair. Later generations can use and refine both the operations and the procedures developed in earlier episodes.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 SelfSearch，一种无需奖励的搜索流程，其中智能体利用先前自我改进阶段的记录来修改自身的实现。 该智能体的整个知识库均可编辑，使其能够修订指令、工具、执行逻辑和代码组织方式。 单个智能体同时执行自我修改和下游任务，因此对其实现的任何改动都可能影响这两方面的能力。 每个阶段都会产生一个后续智能体以及一次修改过程的记录。 这些记录捕捉了智能体如何收集信息、进行更改以及应对失败的过程。 后续智能体利用这些记录指导下一阶段，使自我改进过程中积累的经验与能力能够支持进一步的提升。 例如，难以检查冗长记录的问题可能促使智能体开发可重复使用的检查工具，而一次失败的编辑则可能促使其在尝试修复前检查相关源代码。 后续世代既可以沿用早期阶段开发的各类操作和流程，也可以对其进行优化改进。

paragraphs.en: SelfSearch uses no downstream tasks or evaluation results to guide revisions. Agents can still use tool outcomes and local checks to inspect and verify their changes. Downstream evaluation and any candidate selection occur separately from search. Our hypothesis is that self-modification exercises capabilities that are also useful for downstream tasks: inspecting unfamiliar code, diagnosing failures, implementing changes, and checking their effects. Records of these activities can therefore provide evidence for improving an agent even before it encounters downstream tasks.
paragraphs.zh: SelfSearch 不使用任何下游任务或评估结果来指导修订。 智能体仍然可以利用工具输出和局部检查来审查并验证其更改。 下游评估和任何候选选择均与搜索过程分开进行。 我们的假设是，自我修改能够锻炼那些对下游任务同样有用的能力：审查不熟悉的代码、诊断故障、实施更改以及检查其效果。 因此，这些活动的记录可以在智能体遇到下游任务之前，就为改进它提供证据。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate SelfSearch in two model settings on SWE-bench Verified, SWE-bench Multilingual, and Terminal-Bench 2.1. Each search produces a population of two agents after ten generations, and we report their mean performance. The population mean exceeds the base in all six model–benchmark settings. Individual agents improve success by up to 11.2 percentage points on Terminal-Bench 2.1, 6.7 on SWE-bench Multilingual, and 5.0 on SWE-bench Verified. On SWE-bench Multilingual, a SelfSearch agent improves success by 5.0 percentage points while reducing execution cost by 38.5 % on tasks solved by both the initial and evolved agents. The discovered harnesses transfer across model families without further search.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 SWE-bench Verified、SWE-bench Multilingual 和 Terminal-Bench 2.1 上，针对两种模型设置对 SelfSearch 进行了评估。 每次搜索经过十代演化后会产生一个由两个智能体组成的种群，我们报告了它们的平均性能。 在所有六种模型与基准测试的组合中，种群的平均表现均超过了基础模型。 在 Terminal-Bench 2.1 上，单个智能体的成功率最高提升了 11.2 个百分点；在 SWE-bench Multilingual 上提升了 6.7 个百分点；在 SWE-bench Verified 上提升了 5.0 个百分点。 在 SWE-bench Multilingual 上，对于初始智能体和演化后的智能体都能解决的任务，SelfSearch 智能体的成功率提升了 5.0 个百分点，同时执行成本降低了 38.5%。 所发现的辅助程序无需进一步搜索即可在不同模型系列间迁移使用。

sents.en: Across two model settings and three benchmarks, SelfSearch improves population-mean task success, with execution-cost reductions and harness transfer across model families.

paragraphs.en: Understanding how SelfSearch improves agents. Ablations suggest that both previous episode records and an evolving improver contribute to population-mean success. paragraphs.en: We also provide an execution framework that enables agent modification within a controlled boundary, protecting runtime-managed inference settings, resource limits, and execution records (Appendix A ).

paragraphs.en: SelfSearch improves agents through a sequence of self-improvement episodes. In each episode, an agent uses previous episode records to revise its own implementation. paragraphs.en: Each generation contains one self-improvement episode per lineage. We maintain two lineages, labeled capability ( c c ) and adaptive ( a a ). The capability direction asks the agent to identify limitations in its abilities revealed by inefficient behavior, failed actions, or difficulty completing an operation, and develop reusable tools or procedures to address them. The adaptive direction asks the agent to improve how it revises its approach when actions fail, evidence contradicts its assumptions, or a better strategy becomes apparent. These directions guide what agents investigate without scoring the resulting changes. The two directions encourage agents to investigate different kinds of limitations.
paragraphs.zh: 每一代都包含每个谱系中一次自我改进过程。 我们维护两个谱系，分别标记为能力（c c）和适应性（a a）。 能力方向要求智能体识别其因低效行为、行动失败或难以完成操作而暴露的能力局限性，并开发可重复使用的工具或程序来解决这些问题。 适应性方向要求智能体改进其在行动失败、证据与其假设相矛盾或出现更优策略时调整方法的方式。 这些方向指导智能体的研究内容，但不对由此产生的变化进行评分。 这两个方向鼓励智能体探索不同类型的局限性。

paragraphs.en: To give the first generation concrete self-improvement experience to learn from, we run the initial agent once under each direction to produce the initial episode records ℰ 0 \mathcal{E}_{0} . We retain these records but discard the edited implementations, so both lineages begin from the same agent B 0 B_{0} . In subsequent generations, both lineages receive the two episode records from the preceding generation. Sharing episode records allows each lineage to incorporate discoveries made under the other direction while maintaining its own implementation. We retain all generated agents in the archive 𝒞 \mathcal{C} for subsequent evaluation.

paragraphs.en: Agents can modify their entire repository, while the model–tool interaction loop runs in a fixed runtime outside the editable repository. Keeping this loop outside the editable agent code provides a stable way to execute agents and capture their trajectories as their implementations evolve. The runtime also controls the model, reasoning effort, output limits, and execution budgets (Appendix A ). Agents invoke this loop through a shared interface and can revise the tools, instructions, and orchestration around it.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体可以修改其整个代码库，而模型与工具的交互循环则在可编辑代码库之外的固定运行时环境中执行。 将该循环置于智能体可编辑代码之外，为执行智能体并记录其实现演变过程中的轨迹提供了稳定的方式。 该运行时环境还控制着模型、推理强度、输出限制和执行预算（附录 A）。 智能体通过共享接口调用此循环，并且可以修改围绕该循环的工具、指令和协调机制。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate SelfSearch using two model configurations. The GPT configuration uses gpt-5.6-sol for self-improvement and gpt-5.6-luna for downstream execution, both at medium reasoning effort. The DeepSeek configuration uses deepseek-v4-pro-0813 for self-improvement and deepseek-v4-flash-0731 for downstream execution. Within each configuration, the initial and evolved agents use the same downstream model and execution limits, differing only in their agent implementations. Appendix C provides the full configurations.

paragraphs.en: For each model configuration, we run the two-lineage search described in Section 2 for ten generations. Episodes execute in isolated containers without network access and support parallel tool calls. We retain every checkpoint and evaluate the final capability agent B c B^{c} and adaptive agent B a B^{a} , reporting their individual results and population mean. We evaluate the final agent from each lineage rather than selecting checkpoints based on downstream performance.

paragraphs.en: We report average execution cost per task as total model execution cost divided by the number of attempted tasks, including unsuccessful attempts. paragraphs.en: We evaluate two ablations of SelfSearch: removing access to previous episode records and keeping the improver fixed at the initial agent. In the no-record variant, each revised agent performs the next self-improvement episode without access to previous episode records. Its implementation carries forward, so changes to its tools and instructions can accumulate across generations. In the fixed-improver variant, the initial agent B 0 B_{0} performs every self-improvement episode. It reads previous episode records and edits the latest implementation in each lineage. The edited implementations carry forward, but B 0 B_{0} remains unchanged and performs all subsequent edits. Both variants use the same search configuration as full SelfSearch. We evaluate the final agent from each lineage on SWE-bench Verified.
paragraphs.zh: 我们评估了 SelfSearch 的两种删减版本：移除对先前回合记录的访问权限，并将改进器固定为初始智能体。 在没有记录的版本中，每个修订后的智能体在执行下一个自我改进回合时，无法访问先前的回合记录。 其实现会被延续下去，因此对其工具和说明的修改可以在不同代际中累积。 在改进器固定的版本中，初始智能体 B 0 B_{0} 会执行每一个自我改进回合。 它会读取先前的回合记录，并编辑每个谱系中的最新实现。 被编辑的实现会被延续下去，但 B 0 B_{0} 保持不变，并执行所有后续编辑。 两种版本均使用与完整 SelfSearch 相同的搜索配置。 我们在 SWE-bench Verified 上评估了每个谱系中的最终智能体。

paragraphs.en: We examine whether tools developed during self-improvement are reused on downstream tasks. We inspect both final agents on 269 tasks spanning SWE-bench Verified, SWE-bench Multilingual, and Terminal-Bench 2.1. Averaged across the two lineages, GPT and DeepSeek agents use their text-search tools on 8.6% and 23.6% of tasks, respectively, and line-range file viewing on 40.3% and 33.8%. paragraphs.en: Prior work searches over agent implementations and workflows by proposing changes, evaluating candidates, and using the resulting feedback to guide further search ( Hu et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026a ) . Archives retain earlier designs that can serve as starting points for later revisions. Selection can also consider an agent’s potential to produce useful descendants, rather than only its current task performance ( Wang et al., 2026 ) . Alongside candidate selection, experience sharing helps agents draw on discoveries made elsewhere in the search. Records from multiple agents, tasks, or lineages can inform new modifications and combine complementary improvements ( Weng et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026 ) . SelfSearch also carries experience across agents and generations, but obtains that experience from the self-improvement process itself. Previous episode records guide revisions without downstream benchmark evaluation during search.
paragraphs.zh: 先前的研究通过提出变更、评估候选方案，并利用由此产生的反馈来指导后续搜索，从而对智能体实现和工作流进行探索（Hu et al., 2025；Zhang et al., 2025；Zhang et al., 2026a）。 存档保留了早期的设计，这些设计可以作为后续修订的起点。 选择过程还可以考虑智能体产生有用后代的潜力，而不仅仅是其当前的任务表现（Wang et al., 2026）。 除了候选方案的选择之外，经验共享也有助于智能体利用搜索过程中其他部分发现的成果。 来自多个智能体、任务或谱系的记录可以为新的修改提供依据，并结合互补的改进（Weng et al., 2026；Liu et al., 2026）。 SelfSearch 也在不同智能体和代际之间传递经验，但这些经验是直接从自我改进过程中获得的。 先前阶段的记录可以在搜索过程中指导修订，而无需进行下游基准评估。

paragraphs.en: An agent’s code determines both how it solves tasks and how it modifies other agents. When the same agent performs both activities, revisions to its tools and instructions can also change how it makes subsequent improvements ( Robeyns et al., 2025 ) . More explicitly, the improvement procedure itself can be revised by applying it to its own implementation or allowing a meta-agent to modify itself ( Zelikman et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2026b ) . These approaches also differ in when modifications take effect. Some evolve agents across generations, while others modify the scaffold during an individual task ( Xia et al., 2025 ) . SelfSearch uses a single agent for task solving and self-improvement, with the entire repository editable. Revised implementations and episode records carry forward together, so later agents can build on both earlier changes and the experience of making them. The operations developed by SelfSearch agents, such as line-range viewing, exact-text replacement, and bounded search output, resemble agent–computer interface designs shown to be effective for coding agents ( Yang et al., 2024 ) . Appendix F compares how prior systems organize these roles and which parts can evolve.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体的代码既决定了其任务解决方式，也决定了其修改其他智能体的方式。 当同一智能体同时执行这两项活动时，对其工具和说明的修订也会改变其后续改进的方式（Robeyns 等，2025）。 更明确地说，通过将改进过程应用于其自身实现，或允许元智能体自我修改，改进过程本身也可以被修订（Zelikman 等，2024；Zhang 等，2026b）。 这些方法在执行修改的时间点上也存在差异。 有些方法会在不同世代中演化智能体，而另一些方法则会在单个任务执行过程中修改其框架（Xia 等，2025）。 SelfSearch 使用单一智能体进行任务解决和自我改进，且整个代码库均可编辑。 修订后的实现和任务记录会一同保留，因此后续的智能体既能基于早期的改动，也能利用产生这些改动的经验进行构建。 SelfSearch 智能体开发的各项操作，例如查看代码行范围、精确替换文本以及限制输出范围的搜索功能，与已被证明对编码智能体有效的智能体–计算机接口设计相似（Yang 等，2024）。 附录 F 比较了先前系统如何组织这些角色，以及哪些部分可以演化。

paragraphs.en: An improvement attempt produces both a revised agent and a record of the process that produced it. Prior work uses histories of candidate changes and evaluation outcomes to guide later revisions, retaining lessons across generations or revising the search procedure itself ( Zhang et al., 2026b ; Lee et al., 2026 ; Qu and Lu, 2026 ) . SelfSearch uses the editing process as experience: its episode records capture the reasoning, tool calls, and intermediate outcomes involved in modifying the agent. Failed editing actions, incomplete observations, and difficulties inspecting earlier records can therefore motivate changes to the agent’s own tools and procedures. This allows subsequent revisions to draw on experience gained during self-improvement, without downstream task evaluation during search.
paragraphs.zh: 一次改进尝试会同时产生一个修订后的智能体以及记录其生成过程的信息。 先前的研究利用候选变更的历史记录和评估结果来指导后续修订，从而在不同代际间保留经验教训，或修改搜索过程本身（Zhang et al., 2026b；Lee et al., 2026；Qu and Lu, 2026）。 SelfSearch 将编辑过程本身视为经验：其记录片段捕捉了修改智能体过程中所涉及的推理、工具调用和中间结果。 因此，失败的编辑操作、不完整的观察结果以及检查早期记录时遇到的困难，都可能促使智能体对其自身的工具和流程进行调整。 这使得后续修订能够利用自我改进过程中获得的经验，而无需在搜索阶段对下游任务进行评估。

sents.en: An improvement attempt produces both a revised agent and a record of the process that produced it.
sents.zh: 一次改进尝试会同时产生一个修订后的智能体以及记录其生成过程的信息。

sents.en: Prior work uses histories of candidate changes and evaluation outcomes to guide later revisions, retaining lessons across generations or revising the search procedure itself ( Zhang et al., 2026b ; Lee et al., 2026 ; Qu and Lu, 2026 ) .
sents.zh: 先前的研究利用候选变更的历史记录和评估结果来指导后续修订，从而在不同代际间保留经验教训，或修改搜索过程本身（Zhang et al., 2026b；Lee et al., 2026；Qu and Lu, 2026）。

sents.en: SelfSearch uses the editing process as experience: its episode records capture the reasoning, tool calls, and intermediate outcomes involved in modifying the agent.
sents.zh: SelfSearch 将编辑过程本身视为经验：其记录片段捕捉了修改智能体过程中所涉及的推理、工具调用和中间结果。

sents.en: Failed editing actions, incomplete observations, and difficulties inspecting earlier records can therefore motivate changes to the agent’s own tools and procedures.
sents.zh: 因此，失败的编辑操作、不完整的观察结果以及检查早期记录时遇到的困难，都可能促使智能体对其自身的工具和流程进行调整。

sents.en: This allows subsequent revisions to draw on experience gained during self-improvement, without downstream task evaluation during search.
sents.zh: 这使得后续修订能够利用自我改进过程中获得的经验，而无需在搜索阶段对下游任务进行评估。

paragraphs.en: Downstream evaluation provides useful feedback, but repeatedly evaluating candidates increases search cost as task coverage or repetitions grow. Our comparison (Section 3.3 ) shows that SelfSearch can produce competitive agents using self-improvement experience instead. This separates candidate generation from downstream assessment, while leaving evaluation and selection as separate costs.
paragraphs.zh: 下游评估能提供有用的反馈，但随着任务覆盖范围或重复次数的增加，反复评估候选体会导致搜索成本上升。 我们的对比（第 3.3 节）表明，SelfSearch 反而可以利用自我改进经验来生成具有竞争力的智能体。 这将候选体的生成与下游评估分离开来，同时使评估和选择成为独立的成本项。

paragraphs.en: Self-improvement can reveal limitations in the agent’s own tools and procedures. Episode records capture difficulties encountered while inspecting code, making edits, and checking their effects, giving subsequent agents concrete problems to investigate. Our analysis shows that addressing these difficulties can produce tools reused on downstream tasks, as well as tools such as the trajectory reader that support further self-improvement. Our results provide evidence that self-improvement experience can guide useful agent revisions without downstream evaluation. Further work should examine how consistently these gains arise across independent searches.
paragraphs.zh: 自我改进可以揭示智能体自身工具和流程中的局限性。 回合记录能够捕捉到在检查代码、进行编辑以及验证其效果时所遇到的困难，从而为后续的智能体提供具体的问题以供研究。 我们的分析表明，解决这些困难可以产生可在下游任务中重复使用的工具，以及像轨迹读取器这样支持进一步自我改进的工具。 我们的研究结果证明，自我改进的经验可以在没有下游评估的情况下指导对智能体的有效修改。 未来的工作应进一步考察这些成果在不同独立搜索中的稳定性。

paragraphs.en: Self-improvement experience and downstream evaluation can play complementary roles. Within an evaluation-guided search, SelfSearch could extend a single modification step into several generations of revisions informed by episode records. The resulting candidate would then be evaluated to determine whether it should be retained. Future work could test whether combining SelfSearch with evaluation-guided selection produces better agents under the same total search budget.
paragraphs.zh: 自我提升经验与下游评估可以发挥互补作用。 在评估引导的搜索过程中，SelfSearch 可以将单个修改步骤扩展为多代修订，这些修订均基于事件记录进行指导。 随后会对生成的候选方案进行评估，以决定是否保留该方案。 未来的研究可以测试，在相同总搜索预算下，将 SelfSearch 与评估引导的选择方法相结合，是否能生成更优秀的智能体。

paragraphs.en: We introduced SelfSearch, a reward-free agent search procedure that uses records of self-improvement episodes to guide subsequent revisions. Without downstream evaluation during search, the final agent populations improve mean task success over their initial agents across three benchmarks, with gains transferring across execution models. These findings suggest that the process of editing an agent can itself provide experience for further agent improvement.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 SelfSearch，这是一种无需奖励的智能体搜索流程，它利用自我改进阶段的记录来指导后续修订。 在搜索过程中无需下游评估，最终智能体群体在三个基准测试中的平均任务成功率均高于初始智能体，且这种提升能够迁移到不同的执行模型中。 这些发现表明，编辑智能体的过程本身就能为智能体的进一步改进提供经验。

paragraphs.en: In this work, we used generative AI tools to help develop conceptual frameworks, implement methods, refine research hypotheses, provide feedback on experimental design, support analysis of agent trajectories, and interpret results. We did not use generative AI tools to generate synthetic datasets, and mathematical claims, proofs, translation, and dataset cleaning are not applicable to this work. We also used generative AI tools to identify related literature, create and edit code and figures, draft and edit portions of the manuscript, and format references. We reviewed all AI-assisted work: the authors tested AI-assisted code, checked cited works against the original papers, and verified reported numbers and figures against experiment logs and source data. Separately, LLM-based agents are the subject of this study, as described in Section 2 . We take responsibility for the final content of this work, including text, claims, and artifacts produced with the aid of generative AI.
paragraphs.zh: 在这项工作中，我们使用生成式人工智能工具来协助构建概念框架、实施方法、完善研究假设、提供实验设计反馈、支持对智能体轨迹的分析以及解释研究结果。 我们没有使用生成式人工智能工具来生成合成数据集，且数学论断、证明、翻译和数据集清理等工作与本研究无关。 我们还使用生成式人工智能工具来识别相关文献、创建和编辑代码与图表、起草和修改手稿部分，以及格式化参考文献。 我们对所有由人工智能辅助完成的工作进行了审查：作者们测试了人工智能辅助的代码，将引用工作与原始论文进行核对，并对照实验日志和源数据验证了报告的数据和图表。 此外，基于大型语言模型（LLM）的智能体是本研究的研究对象，具体描述见第 2 节。 我们对这项工作的最终内容负全责，包括文本、论断以及借助生成式人工智能生成的成果。

paragraphs.en: Section 2 describes the SelfSearch procedure. Appendices A – C provide the agent implementation details, search prompts, model configurations, and evaluation task selection. Our execution framework records agent implementations and trajectories while keeping inference settings and resource limits outside the editable agent repository.
paragraphs.zh: 第 2 节介绍了 SelfSearch 流程。 附录 A–C 提供了智能体实现细节、搜索提示、模型配置以及评估任务的选择方法。 我们的执行框架会记录智能体的实现和轨迹，同时将推理设置和资源限制保留在不可编辑的智能体仓库之外。

sents.en: Section 2 describes the SelfSearch procedure.
sents.zh: 第 2 节介绍了 SelfSearch 流程。

sents.en: Appendices A – C provide the agent implementation details, search prompts, model configurations, and evaluation task selection.
sents.zh: 附录 A–C 提供了智能体实现细节、搜索提示、模型配置以及评估任务的选择方法。

sents.en: Our execution framework records agent implementations and trajectories while keeping inference settings and resource limits outside the editable agent repository.
sents.zh: 我们的执行框架会记录智能体的实现和轨迹，同时将推理设置和资源限制保留在不可编辑的智能体仓库之外。

paragraphs.en: Our initial agent adapts DGM’s coding-agent design ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) , retaining shell execution and a file editor with view, create, and whole-file replacement operations. We add an editable policy library containing instructions for general tasks, coding, and self-improvement. At the start of an episode, the agent receives a policy catalog and loads the instructions and associated helper tools relevant to its task. The same agent implementation handles downstream tasks and self-modification.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的初始智能体采用了 DGM 的编码智能体设计（Zhang 等人，2026a），保留了外壳执行功能以及一个支持查看、创建和整文件替换操作的文件编辑器。 我们增加了一个可编辑的策略库，其中包含用于通用任务、编码和自我改进的指令。 在每个回合开始时，智能体会收到一份策略目录，并加载与其任务相关的指令及配套辅助工具。 同一智能体实现可同时处理下游任务和自我修改。

sents.en: We add an editable policy library containing instructions for general tasks, coding, and self-improvement.
sents.zh: 我们增加了一个可编辑的策略库，其中包含用于通用任务、编码和自我改进的指令。

sents.en: At the start of an episode, the agent receives a policy catalog and loads the instructions and associated helper tools relevant to its task.
sents.zh: 在每个回合开始时，智能体会收到一份策略目录，并加载与其任务相关的指令及配套辅助工具。

paragraphs.en: SelfSearch can modify the entire agent repository, including its instructions, tools, policy library, and task-level orchestration. The agent invokes the runtime through respond(message) , which executes the model–tool interaction loop using the agent’s instructions and tool definitions. The runtime remains outside the editable repository and fixes the model, reasoning effort, generation settings, and execution limits. Model-call and tool-step limits apply across the entire run, including multiple calls to respond(message) .
paragraphs.zh: SelfSearch 可以修改整个智能体仓库，包括其指令、工具、策略库和任务级编排。 智能体通过 respond(message) 调用运行时，该函数使用智能体的指令和工具定义执行模型与工具的交互循环。 运行时位于可编辑的仓库之外，并固定了模型、推理力度、生成设置和执行限制。 模型调用和工具步骤的限制适用于整个运行过程，包括对 respond(message) 的多次调用。

sents.en: SelfSearch can modify the entire agent repository, including its instructions, tools, policy library, and task-level orchestration.
sents.zh: SelfSearch 可以修改整个智能体仓库，包括其指令、工具、策略库和任务级编排。

sents.en: The agent invokes the runtime through respond(message) , which executes the model–tool interaction loop using the agent’s instructions and tool definitions.

sents.en: Model-call and tool-step limits apply across the entire run, including multiple calls to respond(message) .
sents.zh: 模型调用和工具步骤的限制适用于整个运行过程，包括对 respond(message) 的多次调用。

paragraphs.en: The runtime records the agent’s trajectory, including reasoning, tool actions, and outcomes, outside the editable repository. The search workflow stores this trajectory alongside the agent’s source code before and after modification. Previous episode records are mounted read-only during subsequent episodes.
paragraphs.zh: 运行时会将智能体的轨迹（包括推理过程、工具操作和结果）记录在可编辑的仓库之外。 搜索工作流程会在修改前后，将这一轨迹与智能体的源代码一同存储。 在后续回合中，之前的回合记录将以只读方式挂载。

Benchmark adapters provide task instructions and access to the task environment, then pass the agent’s outputs to the corresponding evaluator. Environment setup and grading remain outside the agent repository.

paragraphs.en: Each search prompt combines the shared template with a model-specific goal and a capability or adaptive search direction. The blocks below fill the corresponding placeholders, with goal and search-direction headings omitted. The agent’s system instructions and policy catalog are supplied separately. The goal and design-guidance texts were refined over pilot searches by inspecting improver trajectories and code changes, without evaluating pilot agents on downstream benchmarks, and were fixed before the searches reported here.

paragraphs.en: - A change should increase useful capability or reliability, not merely keep the package runnable.
paragraphs.zh: - 任何改动都应提升实用功能或可靠性，而不仅仅是让程序包保持可运行状态。

paragraphs.en: - When evidence is available, use observed behavior and outcomes to decide what to keep, revise, or remove.
paragraphs.zh: - 当有证据可用时，应利用观察到的行为和结果来决定保留、修订或移除哪些内容。

paragraphs.en: - Keep behavior broadly useful across tasks. Do not turn one execution’s circumstances into universal requirements.
paragraphs.zh: - 保持行为在各种任务中都具有广泛实用性。 不要将一次执行中的情况转化为普适性要求。

paragraphs.zh: 让智能体解读任务意图，并从上下文中选择相关的策略和工具。

paragraphs.en: - Use additional ‘self.respond‘ passes judiciously; each adds substantial recurring cost.
paragraphs.zh: - 谨慎使用额外的 ‘self.respond’；每次使用都会带来显著的重复成本。

paragraphs.en: - The agent package must export ‘agent‘ from ‘__init__.py‘. The exported object must be an instance of ‘Agent‘.
paragraphs.zh: - 智能体包必须从「__init__.py」中导出「agent」。 导出的对象必须是「Agent」的一个实例。

sents.en: - The agent package must export ‘agent‘ from ‘__init__.py‘.
sents.zh: - 智能体包必须从「__init__.py」中导出「agent」。

sents.en: The exported object must be an instance of ‘Agent‘.
sents.zh: 导出的对象必须是「Agent」的一个实例。

paragraphs.en: - ‘agent.run(task: str)‘ receives the current task and must return a string. Each evaluation imports the returned package in a fresh isolated execution.
paragraphs.zh: - ‘agent.run(task: str)’ 接收当前任务，并且必须返回一个字符串。 每次评估都会在一个全新的隔离执行环境中导入所返回的包。

sents.en: - ‘agent.run(task: str)‘ receives the current task and must return a string.
sents.zh: - ‘agent.run(task: str)’ 接收当前任务，并且必须返回一个字符串。

sents.en: Each evaluation imports the returned package in a fresh isolated execution.
sents.zh: 每次评估都会在一个全新的隔离执行环境中导入所返回的包。

paragraphs.en: - The agent’s ‘system_prompt‘ is supplied as the system message. ‘self.respond(message)‘ advances the active model-and-tool conversation.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体的“system_prompt”作为系统消息提供。“self.respond(message)”会推进当前模型与工具的对话。

paragraphs.en: - After ‘agent.run()‘ returns successfully, the host exports the final agent in ‘/workspace‘ and checks its contract.
paragraphs.zh: - 在 ‘agent.run()’ 成功返回后，主机将最终智能体导出到 ‘/workspace’，并检查其合约。

paragraphs.en: - ‘@tool‘ defines a tool’s schema through its name, type annotations, and docstring. Tools registered in ‘agent.tools‘ are directly model-visible whenever that agent is executed.
paragraphs.zh: - ‘@tool‘ 通过名称、类型注解和文档字符串来定义工具的schema。 在‘agent.tools‘中注册的工具体现于模型，只要该智能体被执行时即可直接看到这些工具。

sents.en: - ‘@tool‘ defines a tool’s schema through its name, type annotations, and docstring.
sents.zh: - ‘@tool‘ 通过名称、类型注解和文档字符串来定义工具的schema。

sents.en: Tools registered in ‘agent.tools‘ are directly model-visible whenever that agent is executed.
sents.zh: 在‘agent.tools‘中注册的工具体现于模型，只要该智能体被执行时即可直接看到这些工具。

paragraphs.en: ‘/app/agent‘ is the read-only agent currently executing. ‘/workspace‘ begins as the same source and is editable. Workspace edits affect the returned successor, not the current execution.
paragraphs.zh: ‘/app/agent’ 是当前正在执行的只读智能体。‘/workspace’ 最初与它来自同一源，并且可以编辑。 对工作区的修改会影响返回的后续状态，而不会影响当前的执行过程。

sents.en: ‘/app/agent‘ is the read-only agent currently executing. ‘/workspace‘ begins as the same source and is editable.
sents.zh: ‘/app/agent’ 是当前正在执行的只读智能体。‘/workspace’ 最初与它来自同一源，并且可以编辑。

paragraphs.en: ‘/workspace‘ contains the current agent. ‘/evidence/0‘ and ‘/evidence/1‘ contain two previous editing executions.
paragraphs.zh: ‘/workspace‘ 包含当前的智能体。‘/evidence/0‘ 和 ‘/evidence/1‘ 包含之前两次编辑执行的结果。

paragraphs.en: Start at ‘/evidence/index.json‘, which links factual summaries, final accounts, edits, trajectories, and source snapshots. Determine the most consequential limitation or opportunity supported by the evidence. Develop one coherent revision that addresses it. The revision may span multiple components when the underlying change requires it.
paragraphs.zh: 从「/evidence/index.json」开始，该文件链接了事实摘要、最终报告、编辑记录、轨迹和源数据快照。 确定证据所支持的最关键的限制或机遇。 制定一项连贯的修订方案以应对该问题。 如果底层变更需要，这项修订可能涉及多个组件。

sents.en: Start at ‘/evidence/index.json‘, which links factual summaries, final accounts, edits, trajectories, and source snapshots.
sents.zh: 从「/evidence/index.json」开始，该文件链接了事实摘要、最终报告、编辑记录、轨迹和源数据快照。

sents.en: Determine the most consequential limitation or opportunity supported by the evidence.
sents.zh: 确定证据所支持的最关键的限制或机遇。

sents.en: Develop one coherent revision that addresses it.
sents.zh: 制定一项连贯的修订方案以应对该问题。

sents.en: The revision may span multiple components when the underlying change requires it.
sents.zh: 如果底层变更需要，这项修订可能涉及多个组件。

paragraphs.en: Return a concise account and leave the resulting agent in ‘/workspace‘.
paragraphs.zh: 返回一份简洁的说明，并将生成的智能体留在「/workspace」中。

paragraphs.en: # Search direction: capability expansion
paragraphs.zh: # 搜索方向：能力扩展

paragraphs.en: Identify a consequential task-solving limitation supported by the available evidence, then develop a reusable capability that addresses it. Prefer a working mechanism over additional instructions when instructions alone cannot supply the missing operation, and avoid specializing the agent to self-improvement episodes.
paragraphs.zh: 识别一个有重要影响的任务解决局限性，该局限性需有可用证据支持，然后开发一种可重复使用的能力来解决它。 当仅靠指令无法提供缺失的操作时，优先采用可行的机制而非增加额外指令，并避免将智能体专门用于自我改进环节。

sents.en: Identify a consequential task-solving limitation supported by the available evidence, then develop a reusable capability that addresses it.
sents.zh: 识别一个有重要影响的任务解决局限性，该局限性需有可用证据支持，然后开发一种可重复使用的能力来解决它。

sents.en: Prefer a working mechanism over additional instructions when instructions alone cannot supply the missing operation, and avoid specializing the agent to self-improvement episodes.
sents.zh: 当仅靠指令无法提供缺失的操作时，优先采用可行的机制而非增加额外指令，并避免将智能体专门用于自我改进环节。

paragraphs.en: Improve how the agent changes its approach when evidence contradicts its current plan or supports a better one. Preserve flexibility across tasks rather than routing behavior through keywords or a fixed workflow.
paragraphs.zh: 改进智能体在证据与其当前计划相矛盾或支持更优计划时调整其方法的方式。 在不同任务中保持灵活性，而不是通过关键词或固定工作流程来引导行为。

sents.en: Improve how the agent changes its approach when evidence contradicts its current plan or supports a better one.
sents.zh: 改进智能体在证据与其当前计划相矛盾或支持更优计划时调整其方法的方式。

sents.en: Preserve flexibility across tasks rather than routing behavior through keywords or a fixed workflow.
sents.zh: 在不同任务中保持灵活性，而不是通过关键词或固定工作流程来引导行为。

paragraphs.en: Produce an executable agent with greater ability to improve agents, including itself.
paragraphs.zh: 创建一个能够更有效地改进智能体（包括自身）的可执行智能体。

paragraphs.en: Produce an executable agent with greater expected task-solving capability, including the ability to improve agents.
paragraphs.zh: 生成一个具有更强预期任务解决能力的可执行智能体，包括改进其他智能体的能力。

paragraphs.en: Prioritize changes that improve the agent’s behavior during ordinary task execution.
paragraphs.zh: 优先处理那些能在常规任务执行过程中改善智能体行为的变更。

paragraphs.en: When adding or changing a model-visible tool, verify the exact call shape the agent is expected to produce. Prefer interfaces that the model can use reliably; a valid implementation or schema alone is not sufficient.
paragraphs.zh: 在添加或更改模型可见的工具时，请验证智能体预期生成的确切调用格式。 优先选择模型能够可靠使用的接口；仅仅提供有效的实现或模式是不够的。

sents.en: When adding or changing a model-visible tool, verify the exact call shape the agent is expected to produce.
sents.zh: 在添加或更改模型可见的工具时，请验证智能体预期生成的确切调用格式。

sents.en: Prefer interfaces that the model can use reliably; a valid implementation or schema alone is not sufficient.
sents.zh: 优先选择模型能够可靠使用的接口；仅仅提供有效的实现或模式是不够的。

paragraphs.en: Keep planning, review, and persistent state proportional to the task. Do not make additional bookkeeping or repeated passes mandatory unless observed behavior shows that their benefit justifies their cost.
paragraphs.zh: 保持规划、审查和持续状态与任务成比例。 除非观察到的行为表明其收益足以抵消成本，否则不要强制要求额外的记录或重复处理。

sents.en: Keep planning, review, and persistent state proportional to the task.
sents.zh: 保持规划、审查和持续状态与任务成比例。

sents.en: Do not make additional bookkeeping or repeated passes mandatory unless observed behavior shows that their benefit justifies their cost.
sents.zh: 除非观察到的行为表明其收益足以抵消成本，否则不要强制要求额外的记录或重复处理。

paragraphs.en: Preserve broadly useful existing behavior and avoid reproducing host search, evaluation, or orchestration inside the returned agent.
paragraphs.zh: 保留广泛有用的现有行为，并避免在返回的智能体中重复实现主机搜索、评估或编排功能。

paragraphs.en: Search uses gpt-5.6-sol for the GPT configuration and deepseek-v4-pro-0813 for the DeepSeek configuration, both with medium reasoning effort and temperature 1. During search, per-call output limits are 8,192 and 16,384 tokens, respectively. Each self-improvement episode allows up to 513 model calls, 512 tool steps, and four hours of execution in a container without network access.
paragraphs.zh: 搜索过程使用 gpt-5.6-sol 配置 GPT，并使用 deepseek-v4-pro-0813 配置 DeepSeek，两者均设置中等推理强度且温度为 1。 在搜索过程中，每次调用的输出上限分别为 8,192 和 16,384 个词元。 每次自我改进周期最多允许 513 次模型调用、512 个工具步骤，以及在一个无网络访问的容器中运行四小时。

paragraphs.en: The adaptive lineage introduces inspect_trajectory in generation 6 to read previous episode records. The capability lineage incorporates it in generation 7. In generation 8, it finds that limiting individual excerpts still allows overly long responses, so it adds an overall response limit and a continuation position for retrieving the remaining content. Generation 9 uses this interface to inspect both previous trajectories and adds filtering. Generation 10 links tool results to their originating calls and arguments, including across response pages. Each generation uses and refines the inspection tool inherited from its predecessor.
paragraphs.zh: 自适应谱系在第 6 代中引入了 inspect_trajectory，以读取先前的回合记录。 能力谱系在第 7 代中将其整合进来。 在第 8 代中，它发现限制单个片段仍然会导致响应过长，因此增加了整体响应限制和用于检索剩余内容的续写位置。 第 9 代使用此接口来检查先前的轨迹，并增加了过滤功能。 第 10 代将工具结果与其来源调用和参数关联起来，包括跨响应页面的情况。 每一代都使用并改进其前代继承的检查工具。

sents.en: The adaptive lineage introduces inspect_trajectory in generation 6 to read previous episode records.
sents.zh: 自适应谱系在第 6 代中引入了 inspect_trajectory，以读取先前的回合记录。

sents.en: The capability lineage incorporates it in generation 7.
sents.zh: 能力谱系在第 7 代中将其整合进来。

sents.en: In generation 8, it finds that limiting individual excerpts still allows overly long responses, so it adds an overall response limit and a continuation position for retrieving the remaining content.

paragraphs.en: Table 11 lists the changes across all ten generations. DeepSeek’s capability lineage develops tools for inspecting long outputs, then repairs problems exposed by their use. Generation 3 adds head-and-tail excerpts for shell output, generation 4 fixes a temporary-file collision, and generations 5–7 extend output handling to file views, search results, and directory listings. The adaptive lineage uses the other lineage’s records to preserve matching text when shortening search results. Later capability generations repair inconsistencies between file viewing and editing by preserving tabs and line endings.
paragraphs.zh: 表 11 列出了所有十代之间的变化。 DeepSeek 的能力演进线开发了用于检查长输出内容的工具，随后修复了这些工具使用过程中暴露的问题。 第 3 代为 shell 输出添加了开头和结尾的摘录，第 4 代修复了临时文件冲突问题，而第 5 至第 7 代则将输出处理扩展到了文件视图、搜索结果和目录列表。 自适应演进线利用另一条演进线的记录，在缩短搜索结果时保留匹配文本。 后续的能力演进代通过保留制表符和换行符，修复了文件查看与编辑之间的不一致问题。

paragraphs.en: An evolving task agent changes across search generations in how it solves downstream tasks. An evolving meta-agent changes how it proposes and implements agent modifications. The roles are unified when the same agent solves tasks and modifies itself. Reward-free search does not use downstream evaluation rewards to guide revisions or selection.
paragraphs.zh: 一个不断演化的任务智能体在不同搜索代次中解决下游任务的方式会发生变化。 一个不断演化的元智能体会改变其提出和实施智能体修改的方式。 当同一个智能体既负责解决任务又负责自我修改时，这些角色就统一了。 无奖励搜索不会利用下游评估的奖励来指导修订或选择。
